_comment: From wiki.haze-saltborne.com/en/Mechanics/Invocations. Warlocks pick invocations at Warlock levels 1,2,3,4,6 (not tied to invocation tier directly, but chaNeeded gates what's learnable). Only invocations up to tier 4 are listed since that covers everything obtainable in E6 (levels 1-6).

invocations.name: Eldritch Blast
invocations.effect: Fires a blast that deals scaling magic damage, at-will.

invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.effect: Adds Charisma modifier to Eldritch Blast damage.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Whispers
invocations.effect: +1 bonus to all Knowledge checks per Warlock level.

invocations.name: Hideous Blow
invocations.effect: Channels Eldritch Blast into your melee weapon for the next attack.

invocations.name: Beguiling Influence
invocations.effect: +1 Influence checks per Warlock level.

invocations.name: Breath of the Night
invocations.effect: Casts Fog Cloud centered on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: All-Seeing Eyes
invocations.effect: +1 bonus to Spot & Search checks per Warlock level.

invocations.name: Darkness
invocations.effect: Casts Darkness centered on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.effect: Grants Ultravision permanently.

invocations.name: Entropic Warding
invocations.effect: Grants permanent 20% concealment.

invocations.name: See the Unseen
invocations.effect: Casts See Invisibility on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Spider Walk
invocations.effect: Casts Spider Climb on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Call of the Beast
invocations.effect: Casts Aspect of the Wolf on yourself, at-will. Also grants the Animal language.

invocations.name: Frightful Blast
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast forces a Will save or -2 Attack, -2 AC, 20% spell failure for 1 min.

invocations.name: Soul-Reaving Aura
invocations.effect: Passive aura that grants temporary HP.

invocations.name: Summon Entity
invocations.effect: Lets you cast Summon Creature at-will.

invocations.name: Voidsense
invocations.effect: Grants Blindsight out to 10 ft.

invocations.name: Brimstone Blast
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast becomes fire damage; Reflex save or catch fire for multiple rounds.

invocations.name: Eldritch Grace
invocations.effect: Bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier.

invocations.name: Hellrime Blast
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast becomes cold damage; Fortitude save or -4 Dexterity for 10 min.

invocations.name: Stony Grasp
invocations.effect: Attempt to entangle a target in mud and stone.

invocations.name: Sudden Swarm
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast spawns spiders when it kills something.

invocations.name: Beshadowed Blast
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast: Fortitude save or blind for 1 round.

invocations.name: Eldritch Chain
invocations.effect: Eldritch Blast arcs to a second target for half damage.

invocations.name: Dead Walk
invocations.effect: Grants access to Animate Dead at-will.

invocations.name: Walk Unseen
invocations.effect: Casts Invisibility on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Cold Comfort
invocations.effect: Casts Protection from Elements on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Relentless Dispelling
invocations.effect: Grants access to Dispel Magic at-will.

invocations.name: Spider Shape
invocations.effect: Casts Polymorph: Giant Spider on yourself, at-will.

invocations.name: Eldritch Line
invocations.effect: Lets you fire Eldritch Blast as a line attack.

invocations.name: Chilling Tentacles
invocations.effect: Creates a field of tentacles that damage and slow enemies.
